rationale.palette: Derives from Covington's own materials — the Roebling Suspension Bridge's blue-green ironwork, limestone, paper. Not a trend palette.
rationale.bodyFont: Public Sans is the US Web Design System typeface — the body face of American public-sector digital work. Signals the civic register without spending a word of copy on it.
rationale.signature: The catenary divider is the signature: a suspension cable rendered as a hairline SVG between sections.
rationale.themeDefault: Light mode is the default on purpose. Dark-by-default reads as a developer site, and developers are not the audience.

patterns: catenary divider (.span-rule) — SVG suspension-cable hairline used between sections
strand cards (.strands/.strand) — 3-column bordered layout for the 'three things I spend my time on' section
entry rows (.entry) — date / title / tag / arrow grid for writing list items
work items (.item) — two-column title+body / meta grid, grouped under .work-group
